categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: mobile information services and digital marketing services. Mobile information services include domestic and international SMS, video SMS, 5G messaging, voice SMS, and one-click login solutions, serving industries such as finance, internet, e-commerce, and logistics. Digital marketing focuses on short video and information flow advertising, collaborating with leading media platforms like ByteDance and Tencent to provide integrated marketing solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technology platforms integrating big data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to deliver mobile information services. It maintains a comprehensive SMS transmission platform with real-time monitoring and data analytics. For digital marketing, it leverages media platform APIs and AI models, including AI large models for content generation and marketing optimization. The company also supports private deployment and adapts to domestic IT infrastructure standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include top internet companies such as ByteDance, Tencent, Meituan, NetEase, Kuaishou, and Ctrip, as well as financial institutions like Pacific Insurance and various regional banks. The company serves diverse industries including internet, finance, e-commerce, retail, logistics, insurance, education, and healthcare. Its digital marketing clients span e-commerce, logistics, home furnishing, education, and health sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with nearly all revenue generated domestically. It has established regional operation centers in East China, South China, and North China. It also provides international SMS services to support clients' overseas business expansion. Subsidiaries are located in key Chinese cities including Wuxi, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing, Fuzhou, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecommunications and digital marketing supply chains. It procures communication resources directly from major telecom operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom) and third-party suppliers, then provides integrated messaging and marketing services to enterprise customers. It acts as a service integrator and platform operator rather than a telecom infrastructure provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating leadership in mobile information services and expanding digital marketing capabilities. The company invests in R&D projects such as enterprise communication management platforms integrating AI, big data, and cloud computing, and upgrades messaging platforms to support 5G and AI-driven services. It emphasizes innovation in multi-channel messaging, AI model applications in marketing, and compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Talent development and governance enhancement are also key focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from mobile information services, including customized messaging solutions for enterprise clients. Digital marketing revenue comes from integrated advertising services, including media resource procurement, campaign planning, execution, and data analytics. The company also earns investment income from financial products and government subsidies, but these are non-core revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading provider in China's mobile information service industry with strong telecom operator partnerships and a robust technology platform. In digital marketing, it competes by leveraging exclusive media platform agency relationships and comprehensive marketing service capabilities. Major competitors likely include other telecom service aggregators and digital marketing agencies, but the company differentiates through integrated service offerings and deep industry expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.136 billion, a 23.37% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 15.44% to RMB 30.46 million. The mobile information service segment accounted for about 62.78% of revenue, while digital marketing contributed 35.99%. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 1.44 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.18 billion. Despite revenue decline, profitability improved, supported by operational efficiencies and business restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, secure, and efficient mobile information service platform with multi-channel messaging capabilities including SMS, 5G messaging, and video SMS, tailored for diverse industry needs. It offers high-quality telecom resources through stable partnerships with major operators and ensures message delivery reliability with strict content auditing. In digital marketing, it provides end-to-end solutions leveraging top-tier media platforms and AI technologies to optimize marketing effectiveness. Its integrated service model, technological innovation, and strong client relationships create differentiated value for customers.
